verses.en: Then Jonah prayed unto the LORD his God out of the fish’s belly,
verses.pt: E Jonas orou ao SENHOR seu Deus, desde as entranhas do peixe,
verses.en_web: Then Jonah prayed to Yahweh, his God, out of the fish’s belly.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jonah made prayer to the Lord his God from the inside of the fish, and said,

verses.en: And said, I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the LORD, and he heard me; out of the belly of hell cried I, and thou heardest my voice.
verses.pt: E disse: Clamei da minha angústia ao SENHOR, e ele me respondeu; do ventre do Xeol gritei, e tu ouviste minha voz.
verses.en_web: He said, “I called because of my affliction to Yahweh. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.
verses.en_bbe: In my trouble I was crying to the Lord, and he gave me an answer; out of the deepest underworld I sent up a cry, and you gave ear to my voice.

verses.en: For thou hadst cast me into the deep, in the midst of the seas; and the floods compassed me about: all thy billows and thy waves passed over me.
verses.pt: Pois tu me lançaste no profundo, no meio dos mares, e a correnteza me cercou; todas as tuas ondas e tuas vagas passaram sobre mim.
verses.en_web: For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.
verses.en_bbe: For you have put me down into the deep, into the heart of the sea; and the river was round about me; all your waves and your rolling waters went over me.

verses.en: Then I said, I am cast out of thy sight; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple.
verses.pt: E eu disse: Lançado estou de diante de teus olhos; porém voltarei a ver o teu santo templo.
verses.en_web: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’
verses.en_bbe: And I said, I have been sent away from before your eyes; how may I ever again see your holy Temple?

verses.en: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul: the depth closed me round about, the weeds were wrapped about my head.
verses.pt: As águas me cercaram até a alma, o abismo me rodeou; as algas se enrolaram à minha cabeça.
verses.en_web: The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.
verses.en_bbe: The waters were circling round me, even to the neck; the deep was about me; the sea-grass was twisted round my head.

verses.en: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; the earth with her bars was about me for ever: yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O LORD my God.
verses.pt: Desci aos fundamentos dos montes; a terra trancou suas fechaduras a mim para sempre; porém tu tiraste minha vida da destruição, ó SENHOR meu Deus.
verses.en_web: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever: yet have you brought up my life from the pit, Yahweh my God.
verses.en_bbe: I went down to the bases of the mountains; as for the earth, her walls were about me for ever: but you have taken up my life from the underworld, O Lord my God.

verses.en: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the LORD: and my prayer came in unto thee, into thine holy temple.
verses.pt: Quando minha alma desfalecia em mim, eu me lembrei do SENHOR; e minha oração chegou a ti em teu santo templo.
verses.en_web: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered Yahweh. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.
verses.en_bbe: When my soul in me was overcome, I kept the memory of the Lord: and my prayer came in to you, into your holy Temple.

verses.en: They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
verses.pt: Os que dão atenção a coisas inúteis e ilusórias abandonam sua própria misericórdia.
verses.en_web: Those who regard lying vanities forsake their own mercy.
verses.en_bbe: The worshippers of false gods have given up their only hope.

verses.en: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the LORD.
verses.pt: Mas eu porém sacrificarei a ti com voz de gratidão; pagarei o que prometi. A salvação vem do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: But I will make an offering to you with the voice of praise; I will give effect to my oaths. Salvation is the Lord's.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR falou ao peixe, e este vomitou a Jonas em terra firme.
verses.en_web: Then Yahweh spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.
verses.en_bbe: And at the Lord's order, the fish sent Jonah out of its mouth on to the dry land.
